title: AtlasOfAtlases
description: FL-4131 Phase 0: Web atlas-of-atlases binding contract. The web renderer (game_web.html / game_web.cpp) uses this document to locate glyph atlas pages for extended GlyphIds at runtime. Gate: web_atlas_of_atlases_binding. The atlas-of-atlases is separate from the glyph_manifest: the manifest declares identity and coverage; the atlas-of-atlases maps GlyphIds to GPU-ready texture page descriptors for the JavaScript/WebGL side. Must include the manifest_hash (RFC8785+SHA-256) of the glyph manifest it was compiled from so the web side can verify bundle identity.

aoa_version.description: Atlas-of-atlases schema version. Must be 1 for Phase 0.

content_pack_id.description: Must match the content_pack_id from the source glyph manifest.

manifest_hash.description: RFC8785 canonical JSON + SHA-256 hex digest of the source glyph manifest. Gate bundle_compile_identity_includes_glyph_manifest_hash. Web side must reject a bundle whose manifest_hash does not match the locally available manifest file.

fallback_glyph_id.description: Must match fallback_glyph_id from the source glyph manifest. The web renderer substitutes this GlyphId when it encounters an unresolvable extended glyph.

font_id.description: Echo of manifest.font_id used to bake the pages. Web/native loaders may surface this in diagnostics.

font_sha256.description: Echo of manifest.font_sha256. Lets loaders confirm the AOA was baked from the expected font without parsing the manifest.

lut_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the canonical glyph_index payload (RFC8785 sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')). Lets clients confirm the AOA glyph layout matches a precomputed LUT without parsing the full glyph_index.

pages.description: Atlas page list. Web renderer loads these as GPU textures. Phase 1+ may emit one entry per cell_px for the manifest's supported_cell_sizes ladder.

glyph_index.description: Compact mapping from GlyphId to [page_index, u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max]. Keys are string-encoded GlyphIds (to be JSON-safe). The web renderer uses this as the primary lookup table for extended glyphs.

page_id.description: Page identifier matching the source manifest atlas_pages entry.

url.description: URL or asset-relative path to the atlas PNG/WebP texture. Relative paths are computed from the same base as game_web.html.

cell_px.description: Phase 1+ pixel size of each glyph cell on this page. Runtime selects the page whose cell_px best matches the current terminal/render font size.

page_hash.description: Phase 1+ lowercase hex SHA-256 over the raw RGBA8 pixel bytes of this page. Lets loaders detect tampered/divergent atlas pages without re-rasterizing.

page_binding_kind.description: GPU texture binding strategy. 'atlas_rect' = sub-rect UVs within a 2D texture (required for WebGL1 web targets). 'array_layer' = layer index in a 2D texture array (WebGL2 or native only). Web targets must use 'atlas_rect'.

format.description: Texture format hint for the web renderer. 'rgba8' (default) or 'r8' for single-channel coverage pages.
